text_blocks.snippet: The National Archives receives funding through Congressional appropriations and also manages grant programs to support historical records preservation and access. The National Historical Publications and Records Commission (NHPRC), within the National Archives, offers grants for various projects like publishing historical records and supporting archival initiatives. In the current fiscal year, the National Archives is requesting a discretionary budget of $414.7 million.
